title: "Quarto → Slidesfly"
subtitle: "Render one portable HTML deck, then publish one shareable URL"
author: "Slidesfly"
output-file: index.html
include-in-header: favicon.html
format:
  revealjs:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: black
    css: slidesfly.css
    html-math-method: plain
    slide-number: true
    transition: fade
    controls: true
    progress: true
    hash: false
    width: 1280
    height: 720
---

## Build one portable artifact

```bash
quarto render slides.qmd --output-dir build
node ../inject-slidesfly-reader-bridge.mjs build/index.html quarto
```

`embed-resources: true` packages the Reveal.js runtime and local presentation resources into
`build/index.html`. The injector installs an early in-memory storage fallback for Slidesfly's
opaque-origin sandbox and adds the standard reader navigation bridge.

## Validate before publishing

```bash
node validate.mjs build/index.html
```

- Confirm every slide renders.
- Test Left/Right keyboard navigation.
- Check the browser console and network panel.
- Keep credentials, claim tokens, and private content out of the deck.

## Publish the generated HTML

```bash
node ../../skills/slidesfly/scripts/slidesfly.mjs publish \
  ./build/index.html \
  --title "Quarto publishing example" \
  --visibility public \
  --json
```

The verified Quarto `1.10.18` artifact is about 3.3 MiB, so this example uses an authenticated Free
or higher publishing path rather than the current 1 MiB anonymous path.

## Verify the reader, not just the build

1. Open the returned `slidesfly.xyz` reader URL.
2. Navigate across all five slides inside the sandboxed reader.
3. Record the exact Quarto version, artifact checksum, and verification date.
4. Treat build, browser, and live-reader checks as separate evidence.

<p class="muted">Source first. Reproducible build. Verifiable reader.</p>
